mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.code, s.sc_id, s.customer_id, s.saler_id, s.order_date, s.payment_date, s.sale_order_id, s.total_num, s.confirm_num, s.total_gift_num, s.total_amount, s.confirm_amt, s.total_cost, s.paid_amount, s.total_profit, s.fill_all_cost, s.description, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.approve_by, s.approve_time, s.status, s.refuse_reason, s.settle_status, s.settle_version FROM tbl_sale_out_sheet AS s LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_order AS o ON o.id = s.sale_order_id LEFT JOIN base_data_customer AS cu ON cu.id = s.customer_id

SELECT s.id, s.code, s.sc_id, s.customer_id, s.saler_id, s.order_date, s.payment_date, s.sale_order_id, s.total_num, s.confirm_num, s.total_gift_num, s.total_amount, s.confirm_amt, s.paid_amount, s.total_cost, s.total_profit, s.fill_all_cost, s.description, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.approve_by, s.approve_time, s.status, s.refuse_reason, s.settle_status, d.id AS detail_id, b.main_product_id AS detail_main_product_id, d.product_id AS detail_product_id, g.inquiry_product AS detail_inquiry_product, d.order_num AS detail_order_num, d.confirm_num AS detail_confirm_num, d.unit_id AS detail_unit_id, d.unit_name AS detail_unit_name, d.conversion_rate AS detail_conversion_rate, d.business_num AS detail_business_num, d.ori_price AS detail_ori_price, d.tax_price AS detail_tax_price, d.confirm_amt AS detail_confirm_amt, d.discount_rate AS detail_discount_rate, d.is_gift AS detail_is_gift, d.tax_rate AS detail_tax_rate, d.description AS detail_description, d.order_no AS detail_order_no, d.settle_status AS detail_settle_status, d.sale_order_detail_id AS detail_sale_order_detail_id, d.tax_amount AS detail_tax_amount, d.cost_price AS detail_cost_price, d.manual_input_cost AS detail_manual_input_cost, d.total_profit AS detail_total_profit, d.plan_date AS detail_plan_date, c.name AS category_name FROM tbl_sale_out_sheet AS s LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_out_sheet_detail AS d ON d.sheet_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_out_sheet_detail_bundle AS b ON b.sheet_id = s.id AND b.product_detail_id = d.id LEFT JOIN base_data_product AS g ON g.id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_category AS c ON c.id = g.category_id

SELECT s.id, s.code, s.customer_id, cu.code AS customer_code, cu.name AS customer_name, s.order_date, d.plan_date, s.sale_order_id, o.code AS sale_order_code, d.id AS detail_id, d.product_id, g.code AS product_code, g.name AS product_name, g.remark AS product_remark, g.remark2 AS product_remark2, g.inquiry_product AS inquiry_product, g.sku_code, g.external_code, g.spec, d.unit_name AS unit, c.name AS category_name, b.name AS brand_name, d.business_num AS order_num, d.confirm_num, d.tax_price, d.tax_amount, d.confirm_amt, d.cost_price * COALESCE(d.conversion_rate, 1) AS cost_price, d.total_profit, d.is_gift, d.description, s.description AS sheet_description, d.settle_status, s.create_by, s.create_time, au.name AS approve_by, s.approve_time, s.status, d.supplier_id FROM tbl_sale_out_sheet AS s INNER JOIN tbl_sale_out_sheet_detail AS d ON d.sheet_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tbl_sale_order AS o ON o.id = s.sale_order_id LEFT JOIN base_data_customer AS cu ON cu.id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product AS g ON g.id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_unit AS u ON u.id = g.unit LEFT JOIN base_data_product_category AS c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_brand AS b ON b.id = g.brand_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS au ON au.id = s.approve_by

choose.when: AND (CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.confirm_amt, 0) != 0 THEN s.confirm_amt ELSE s.total_amount END) <= IFNULL(s.paid_amount, 0)
choose.otherwise: AND (CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.confirm_amt, 0) != 0 THEN s.confirm_amt ELSE s.total_amount END) > IFNULL(s.paid_amount, 0)

if.if: AND ((CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.confirm_amt, 0) != 0 THEN s.confirm_amt ELSE s.total_amount END) - IFNULL(s.paid_amount, 0)) >= #{vo.unpaidAmountStart}
AND ((CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.confirm_amt, 0) != 0 THEN s.confirm_amt ELSE s.total_amount END) - IFNULL(s.paid_amount, 0)) <= #{vo.unpaidAmountEnd}

mapper.select: ORDER BY s.order_date DESC, g.name ASC, s.code DESC, d.order_no ASC

SELECT s.id, s.code, s.sc_id, s.customer_id, s.saler_id, d.id AS detail_id, d.sheet_id AS detail_sheet_id, d.product_id AS detail_product_id, d.order_num AS detail_order_num, d.confirm_num AS detail_confirm_num, d.ori_price AS detail_ori_price, d.tax_price AS detail_tax_price, d.confirm_amt AS detail_confirm_amt, d.discount_rate AS detail_discount_rate, d.is_gift AS detail_is_gift, d.tax_rate AS detail_tax_rate, d.description AS detail_description, d.order_no AS detail_order_no, d.return_num AS detail_return_num FROM tbl_sale_out_sheet AS s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.id, d.sheet_id, d.product_id, l.order_num, d.confirm_num, d.ori_price, d.tax_price, d.confirm_amt, d.discount_rate, d.is_gift, d.tax_rate, d.description, d.order_no, l.return_num, l.order_no AS lot_order_no FROM tbl_sale_out_sheet_detail AS d INNER JOIN tbl_sale_out_sheet_detail_lot AS l ON l.detail_id = d.id AND l.order_num > l.return_num WHERE d.sheet_id = #{id} ) AS d ON d.sheet_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status = 3 order by d.order_no, d.lot_order_no
